name: mirage
text: No file needed: the phone already sends the full report to GitHub every 20 min and I just read the 18:00 one. It shows the lag: with no scan running, 27% of screen frames are slow, 9 froze (worst 5.9 s). During a scan the garbage collector took 49% of CPU and background work 146%, so something heavy is churning memory. Next: a ranked 'lag' finding at the top of the report, then find and fix what runs in the background while you type and scroll. Logged as PF3.
